description: ide.cime.es: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ide.cime.es. Coverage: the area served by ide.cime.es. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Conducció en alta d'aigua potable; Xarxa de distribució d'aigua potable; Captació d'aigua potable (pou); NNSS_Sant Lluís. Estructura General i Orgànica del Territori. Captacio. Formats seen: WMS, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
